title: sisymbrium pyrenaicum subsp. austriacum
intro: Sisymbrium pyrenaicum subsp. austriacum, commonly known as Austrian hedge mustard, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include its antioxidant properties and its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Austrian hedge mustard include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, its ability to protect against oxidative stress, and its potential application in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, such as glucoraphanin and sinigrin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
